title: SessionEnd hook marks the session record closed

truths: A SessionEnd hook invocation with a session record on disk leaves that record with status "closed" and a closed_at timestamp
A Stop or PreCompact invocation never writes a closed mark
Claude hook wiring registers SessionEnd -> bee-session-close.mjs and the rendered manifests match the wiring tests

action: In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/session_close/mod.rs run_inner: add an early branch for ctx.event == "SessionEnd" — resolve session_id via get_session_id(&ctx.payload); if present, under the sessions store lock (same acquire pattern as state_sync.rs heartbeat_session, fail-open on Busy/missing record) set status:"closed" and closed_at:<now ISO> on .bee/sessions/<id>.json, print nothing, return Ok(()). Never mark on Stop/PreCompact. In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/onboard/hooks_wiring.rs: add a SessionEnd entry pointing at bee-session-close.mjs in the Claude wiring arms (same repo_entry shape as the existing Stop entry); Codex runtime has no SessionEnd event — leave codex arms unchanged with a one-line comment naming the gap. Regenerate rendered hook manifests exactly as the repo does (find the regen path: bee dev render-hook-manifests or the build step that renders packages/bee/hooks/*.json) and update the wiring/installer tests that pin the manifest content (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/tests/installer_contracts.rs and hooks_wiring tests). Add a session_close test: SessionEnd payload with a session record → record gains status closed + closed_at; Stop payload → record untouched.
intent: bee wires Stop/PreCompact/SubagentStop but not SessionEnd, so a cleanly exited session is indistinguishable from a live one until its heartbeat goes stale (900s). Recording closure at exit is the safe signal guards can release on.
